SendingˆaˆdomesticˆwireˆDomesticˆwiresˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆanotherˆUSˆbankˆaccountˆonˆtheˆsameˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆsendˆaˆwireˆ1.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆWire.ˆ2.ˆEnterˆtheˆrecipient'sˆname,ˆbankˆroutingˆnumber,ˆaccountˆnumberˆandˆaddress.ˆ3.ˆReviewˆtheˆfeeˆandˆconfirmˆwithˆyourˆpasscode.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆWiresˆsubmittedˆbeforeˆ3:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆareˆsentˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆLaterˆwiresˆareˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆDailyˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ$25,000ˆ|ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆsendˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆsent.ˆDouble-checkˆtheˆdetails,ˆandˆbeˆcarefulˆifˆsomeoneˆyou'veˆonlyˆmetˆonline,ˆorˆsomeoneˆclaimingˆtoˆbeˆfromˆaˆbankˆorˆtheˆgovernment,ˆasksˆyouˆtoˆwireˆmoney.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="wires-international">
SendingˆanˆinternationalˆwireˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆsendˆinternationalˆwiresˆfromˆtheˆapp.ˆInternationalˆwiresˆaren'tˆavailableˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆsendˆoneˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆWire,ˆthenˆInternational.ˆYou'llˆneedˆtheˆrecipient'sˆnameˆandˆaddress,ˆtheirˆbank'sˆSWIFTˆcode,ˆandˆtheirˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆIBAN.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆandˆtimingˆInternationalˆwiresˆsubmittedˆbeforeˆ1:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆareˆsentˆthatˆday.ˆTheyˆusuallyˆarriveˆinˆ1ˆtoˆ5ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆdependingˆonˆtheˆcountryˆandˆanyˆbanksˆinˆbetween.ˆ##ˆFeesˆ-ˆPlus:ˆ$35.00ˆperˆwireˆ-ˆPremium:ˆ$10.00ˆperˆwireˆBanksˆalongˆtheˆway,ˆandˆtheˆreceivingˆbank,ˆmayˆtakeˆtheirˆownˆfeesˆfromˆtheˆamount.ˆ##ˆCurrencyˆInternationalˆwiresˆareˆsentˆinˆUSˆdollars.ˆTheˆreceivingˆbankˆconvertsˆthemˆatˆitsˆownˆrate.ˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆsent.ˆWiresˆtoˆcomprehensivelyˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆareˆblocked.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="wires-premium">
WireˆfeesˆonˆPremiumˆHere'sˆwhatˆwiresˆcostˆonˆtheˆPremiumˆplan.ˆ|ˆWireˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆdomesticˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆYouˆcanˆsendˆupˆtoˆ$25,000ˆaˆdayˆinˆdomesticˆwiresˆonˆPremium.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆtimesˆDomesticˆwiresˆsentˆbeforeˆ3:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆgoˆoutˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆInternationalˆwiresˆsentˆbeforeˆ1:00ˆPMˆETˆgoˆoutˆtheˆsameˆdayˆandˆarriveˆinˆ1ˆtoˆ5ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆsendˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆthey'reˆsent.ˆCheckˆtheˆrecipient'sˆname,ˆbankˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆcarefully.ˆBeˆwaryˆofˆanyoneˆwhoˆpressuresˆyouˆtoˆwireˆmoneyˆquickly,ˆespeciallyˆsomeoneˆyou'veˆonlyˆmetˆonline.ˆOtherˆbanksˆinvolvedˆinˆtheˆwireˆmayˆchargeˆtheirˆownˆfees,ˆwhichˆcanˆreduceˆtheˆamountˆtheˆrecipientˆgets.ˆWeˆshowˆourˆfeeˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
